name: Glint Dissolve
description: The bright points of the first clip sparkle into crisp four-point star glints that swell and twinkle up to the cut, then shrink back into the highlights of the second clip, which stays sharp. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: size
params.description: Length of the longest rays of the glints at the peak, in frame heights

params.name: threshold
params.description: Brightness above which the picture sparkles

params.name: diagonals
params.description: Add a shorter, softer pair of diagonal rays to each glint

params.name: rotation
params.description: Angle of the cross, in degrees

params.name: tint
params.description: Tint of the glints, added as light
